title: Legal Standards / Guidelines for Trademark Usage
slide_intent: Treat a trademark as a distinct modifier rather than an interchangeable product name so readers can separate brand identity from the generic item.
strategic_value: Consistent naming examples can help Burger King partners maintain recognizable wording across written materials.
demonstration: Two content columns present three numbered topics: distinguishing marks, pairing marks with generic names, and copy specifications, with correct and incorrect examples.
practical_value: Use the paired examples to check capitalization, generic nouns and line breaks while retaining the guide’s historical legal-review context.

content_islands.name: Section label
content_islands.spec: Place the compact trademark-usage heading at left.

content_islands.name: Distinction and generic nouns
content_islands.spec: Stack numbered topics one and two in the central column with correct/incorrect copy examples.

content_islands.name: Copy specifications
content_islands.spec: Place topic three at right, including trade-name capitalization, notation and the prohibition on splitting marks across lines.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that the generic noun should keep the trademark from becoming the generic name.
reference_purposes.Application: Correct and incorrect examples compare marked names, generic nouns and company trade names.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The historical source requires marks to be distinguished, generic nouns after the first or most prominent use per page, and no line break within the company’s trademarks.

ingredient.name: Trademark wording in copy
ingredient.role: Distinguish the branded name from the product or company description.
ingredient.application: Follow the source’s distinction and generic-noun examples; keep BURGER KING together on one line and distinguish trademarks from company trade names.
ingredient.scope: Historical legal-copy guidance. The page’s notation wording is not a substitute for its earlier country-specific legal instructions.
